screen.analog_alu.boule.title: Silicon Boule Process
screen.analog_alu.boule.line1: Combine sand and a diamond to make a silicon boule.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line2: Blast for 1,200 ticks to make metallurgical silicon.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line3: Combine silicon with nether quartz for a purification charge.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line4: Blast for 2,400 ticks to obtain purified silicon.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line5: Add an amethyst seed, then grow a crystal for 3,000 ticks.
screen.analog_alu.boule.line6: Use a cutting wire on the crystal to get eight wafers.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.title: Mass Analyzer Operation
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line1: Throw ion-implanted silicon onto the machine.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line2: Power it with copper wire or redstone.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line3: Supply signal strength 8+ for 2.5 cumulative minutes.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line4: Progress pauses without signal and resumes later; input is retained.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line5: Accumulate 3,000 powered ticks to finish processing.
screen.analog_alu.analyzer.line6: Mass-selected silicon is ejected above the machine.
screen.analog_alu.wafer.title: Silicon Wafer Editor
screen.analog_alu.wafer.instruction_orde: Module first; declare ports/storage before statements (1 ms each).
screen.analog_alu.wafer.instruction_widt: 4-bit values; CRAM + rounded-up FF bytes must be <= 512.
screen.analog_alu.wafer.example: Example: let c = (a ++ b).carry; front = +(a, b);
block.analog_alu.mass_analyzer.descripti: Throw in ion-implanted silicon; supply signal strength 8+ for 2.5 cumulative minutes. Progress pauses without signal.
message.analog_alu.wafer_no_program: No valid compiled wafer program is stored.

book.analog_alu.guide.page1:
ANALOG ALU
Guide Book

1. Oil  2. Oil Processor
3. Electricity  4. Generators
5. Batteries  6. Miner & Hoppers
7. Silicon  8. Utilities
9. Converters  10. Petrochemicals
11. Shocks  12. Clothing
13. Asphalt
14. Stun Gun
book.analog_alu.guide.page2:
1. OIL

Oil forms large underground deposits. Most of them show up as wide black lakes on the surface.

Right-click an oil source with an empty bucket to collect 1 Oil. The bucket is not used up, and Oil stacks to 64.
book.analog_alu.guide.page3:
Oil flows slowly. You can swim in it (jump to rise), but you can barely see and slowly drown. Oil burns: fire and lava ignite it and burn it away.

Oil Drill: pumps one source within 64 blocks below every 30 s.

Smelt Solid Oil for Oil.
book.analog_alu.guide.page4:
2. OIL PROCESSOR

Right-click with oil to insert (sneak: a stack). Holds 64; hoppers work too.

Needs lava, fire, a lit furnace or campfire directly below.

After 20 s each oil gives Diesel, Naphtha and Asphalt.
book.analog_alu.guide.page5:
3. ELECTRICITY

Copper Cable carries current. Devices connect through two terminals: the front is +, the back is -. Current needs a closed loop from + back to -.

Look at a cable or device to see its voltage, current and temperature.
book.analog_alu.guide.page6:
Each circuit may have only one generator or Battery. Too much current overheats and damages cables.

Circuit Switch: right-click to open or close it.

Resistive Load: a 10 Ω test load.
book.analog_alu.guide.page7:
4. GENERATORS

Coal: 12 V. Right-click with coal.
Diesel: 24 V. Right-click with Diesel; holds 128.
Sneak-click inserts the stack. Hoppers can refuel both.

Wind: open sky at Y 80+.
Solar: daylight and open sky.
book.analog_alu.guide.page8:
5. BATTERIES

Battery: 9 V, 36 kJ. Starts full and cannot be recharged. Once placed, mining it gives a Used Battery (0 J).

Rechargeable Battery: 12 V, 72 kJ. Starts empty. Wire it into a circuit with a generator to charge it. Without a generator it powers the circuit itself. It keeps its charge when mined.
book.analog_alu.guide.page9:
6. MINER & HOPPERS

Miner: with 4 V+ and a redstone signal it mines the block in front.

Every machine outputs into a hopper below, else a hopper above (upward hoppers too), else drops items on top. Hoppers can feed machines.
book.analog_alu.guide.page10:
7. SILICON

Sand + diamond = Silicon Boule. Blast it into Silicon. Add quartz and blast for Purified Silicon. Add an amethyst shard and blast for Monocrystalline Silicon. Cut it with a Wafer Cutting Wire into 8 wafers.
book.analog_alu.guide.page11:
Program a wafer, add quartz and blast it. Feed the result to a Mass Analyzer with signal 8+. Surround the output with 8 redstone torches, add Strong Ion Gas, and blast for a Semiconductor.

Book + redstone = programming guide.
book.analog_alu.guide.page12:
8. UTILITIES

Chunk Loader keeps its chunk loaded; Chunk Loader II loads 3x3 chunks.

Upward Hopper moves items up. Sneak-right-click toggles ejection.

CRAM, gates and LEDs treat redstone strength 0-15 as a 4-bit value.
hover.analog_alu.hint.converter: Right-click to set the target voltage
book.analog_alu.guide.page13:
9. CONVERTERS

They link two circuits. Input: front + / back -. Output: top + / bottom -.

Right-click opens a window to type the target voltage.
Step-Up: up to 3 kV.
Step-Down: up to 1 kV.

Efficiency 90%. Above 60 V the casing shocks.
tooltip.analog_alu.revolver: Press R to cock before every shot. Once all six are gone, R reloads (4 s)
tooltip.analog_alu.musket: Loads one ball at a time as it fires. 3 s between shots
tooltip.analog_alu.shotgun: R reloads (3.5 s) for two shots
message.analog_alu.gun.cock_first: Press R to cock the hammer
message.analog_alu.gun.musket_loads_itse: The musket loads itself as it fires
hover.analog_alu.hint.chemical_reactor: Hold an input and right-click; empty hand: change process
hover.analog_alu.hint.chlorine_generator: Right-click with a water bucket; needs 4 V+
screen.analog_alu.converter.hint_up: Inputs above the target pass through unchanged.
screen.analog_alu.converter.hint_down: Inputs below the target pass through unchanged.
tooltip.analog_alu.bare_cable: Bare: shocks anyone who touches it while live
tooltip.analog_alu.insulated_cable: Safe to touch up to %s V
tooltip.analog_alu.sneakers: Never wears out · Enchantable · +20% speed · No hunger from walking, sprinting or jumping · Steps up 1.8 blocks
tooltip.analog_alu.insulated_boots: Blocks all electric shocks except stun guns (wears out)
book.analog_alu.guide.page14:
10. PETROCHEMICALS

Chemical Reactor: an electric load (front +/back -, 12 V+). Empty-hand right-click picks the process. Insert inputs by hand or hopper.

Chlorine Generator (4 V+): water bucket -> Chlorine + Hydrogen.
book.analog_alu.guide.page15:
Naphtha x2 -> Ethylene x2, Propylene, C4, Pyrolysis Gasoline
Gasoline x2 -> Benzene, p-Xylene
C4 -> Butadiene
Hydrogen x3 -> Ammonia x2
Ethylene x2 -> PE
Propylene x2 -> PP
Ethylene+Chlorine -> Vinyl Chloride; x2 -> PVC
book.analog_alu.guide.page16:
Ethylene+Water -> Glycol
p-Xylene -> Terephthalic Acid
Acid+Glycol -> PET
Propylene+Ammonia -> Acrylonitrile; x2 -> PAN
Benzene+H2 x2 -> Adipic Acid
Adipic+NH3 x2 -> HMDA
Adipic+HMDA -> Nylon
Benzene+Ethylene -> Styrene
Butadiene x3+Styrene -> Rubber x2
book.analog_alu.guide.page17:
11. SHOCKS

Touching a live bare copper cable hurts: damage = volts x amps x 0.05, ignoring armor. The - side is 0 V and safe.

PVC cable is safe up to 600 V, PP cable up to 1000 V.
Insulated Boots block all shocks (not stun guns) but wear out.
book.analog_alu.guide.page18:
12. CLOTHING

PET/Nylon/PAN -> fibers x3.
Suit, Decorated Suit, Wool/Cotton Trousers, Skirt: no durability.
Sneakers (rubber): never wear out, enchantable, +20% speed, no hunger walking, sprinting or jumping, step up 1.8 blocks.

13. ASPHALT
Asphalt + gravel + sand. +20% speed for everything, blast-proof, dyeable.
message.analog_alu.stun_gun_boss: Bosses are immune to the stun gun
tooltip.analog_alu.stun_gun: Right-click a mob: 2 damage + 2 s stun, 10 s cooldown
book.analog_alu.guide.page19:
14. STUN GUN

Battery (unused) + nylon housing + copper cable electrodes.

Right-click a creature: 2 damage that ignores armor and a 2 s stun. 10 s cooldown. 32 uses; it cannot be recharged or repaired. Bosses are immune.
message.analog_alu.resin_none: No Plastic Resin in your inventory
book.analog_alu.petro.page1:
PETROCHEMISTRY

1. Naphtha
2. Chemical Reactor
3. Chlorine Generator
4. Power tips
5. Base processes
6. PE / PP / PVC
7. PET
8. PAN / Nylon
9. Rubber
10. Uses
book.analog_alu.petro.page2:
1. NAPHTHA

Oil Processor (heat below) turns each oil into Diesel, Naphtha and Asphalt.

Naphtha is where all plastics start. Old Plastic Resin can be swapped for Naphtha at a Resin Converter.
book.analog_alu.petro.page3:
2. CHEMICAL REACTOR

An electric load: front +, back -, 8 ohm. Needs 12 V or more across it.

Empty-hand right-click: next process (sneak: previous). Stored inputs are ejected when you switch.
book.analog_alu.petro.page4:
Inputs: right-click while holding them (sneak: whole stack) or feed with hoppers. Up to 64 each.

Each process needs a fixed energy in joules; more watts = faster.

Outputs go to a hopper below, else above, else on top.
book.analog_alu.petro.page5:
3. CHLORINE GENERATOR

Load: front +, back -, 6 ohm, needs 4 V+.

Right-click with a water bucket (you keep the empty bucket). Hoppers can insert water buckets too.

Water + 1600 J -> Chlorine + Hydrogen.
book.analog_alu.petro.page6:
4. POWER TIPS

Coal generator (12 V) sags below 12 V on the reactor, so it will NOT run it.

Diesel generator (24 V): about 64 W, naphtha cracking in ~47 s.

Or use a Step-Up Converter set to 24-48 V.
book.analog_alu.petro.page7:
5. BASE PROCESSES

Naphtha x2 (3000 J)
-> Ethylene x2, Propylene, C4 Fraction, Pyrolysis Gasoline

Gasoline x2 -> Benzene + p-Xylene
C4 -> Butadiene
Hydrogen x3 -> Ammonia x2
book.analog_alu.petro.page8:
6. PE / PP / PVC

Ethylene x2 -> PE
Propylene x2 -> PP

Ethylene + Chlorine -> Vinyl Chloride
Vinyl Chloride x2 -> PVC

PVC needs a chlorine generator first.
book.analog_alu.petro.page9:
7. PET

Ethylene + Water Bucket -> Ethylene Glycol
p-Xylene -> Terephthalic Acid

Terephthalic Acid + Ethylene Glycol -> PET
book.analog_alu.petro.page10:
8. PAN / NYLON

Propylene + Ammonia -> Acrylonitrile
Acrylonitrile x2 -> PAN

Benzene + Hydrogen x2 -> Adipic Acid
Adipic Acid + Ammonia x2 -> HMDA
Adipic Acid + HMDA -> Nylon 66
book.analog_alu.petro.page11:
9. RUBBER

Benzene + Ethylene -> Styrene
Butadiene x3 + Styrene -> Synthetic Rubber x2 (SBR)

One naphtha cracking gives one C4, so collect Butadiene from several runs.
book.analog_alu.petro.page12:
10. USES

PVC: insulated cable (8 copper cables + 1), safe to 600 V; insulated boots
PP: insulated cable, safe to 1000 V
PE: chlorine generator
Nylon: stun gun, nylon fiber
Rubber: sneakers, boots
book.analog_alu.petro.page13:
FIBERS & CLOTHES

PET -> Polyester Fiber x3
Nylon -> Nylon Fiber x3
PAN -> Acrylic Fiber x3

Polyester: Suit, Cotton Trousers
Acrylic: Wool Trousers
Nylon: Skirt, Decorated Suit, Sneakers
